maria: Quick heads-up — ran nvprof + perf script on the staging INT8 vs FP8 decoder runs. Seeing dequant_host_copy spikes dominating tail p95. Trace uploaded to the perf bucket but pasting snippets below.

sam: Can you paste the nvprof summary here? curious if it's kernel-side stalls or host memcpy.

maria: nvprof summary (trimmed):
```
GPU activities: %Time  Calls  Avg(ms)  Name
28.5%   102    0.12     dequant_host_copy
22.1%   204    0.09     cublasGemmEx_int8
10.4%   306    0.03     kernel_attention_fp8
9.7%    150    0.04     memcpy_htoh
7.2%    480    0.01     launch_overhead
```

lucas: Is this isolated to INT8 path? how does FP8 compare?

maria: FP8 run looked different — dequant_host_copy ~6% and GEMM dominated (~30%). So INT8 path seems to trigger host fallback / extra host <-> device copies in our dequant pipeline.

devin: Were you running with KV prefetch on? we've seen prefetch + batching cause extra host memcpys when prefetch touches noncontiguous pages.

maria: Prefetch was on (default). Did an ablation: prefetch=off -> p95 down ~18%, dequant_host_copy drops to ~12%.

perf-bot: perf script heatmap uploaded: gs://redwood-perf/staging/1943210000/heatmap.png :eyes:

sam: Can you post a perfetto timeline snapshot too? i'd like to see kernel overlap and whether memcpy is blocking GEMM launches. Also what was the sequence length distribution for the run? long tail sequences can amplify host-copy cost.

maria: perfetto snippet (timeline):
```
[time axis]
| memcpy HtD (dequant_host_copy) | --- blocks ---> | kernel_gemm_int8 | kernel_attention |
Observed: repeated host copies serializing GEMM launches ~40-60us gaps between launches.
Sequence length p75=256, p95=768, p99=1024 — we hit long sequences frequently on this sample set.
```

lucas: Hypothesis: prefetch heuristic is over-eager for INT8 batching case and issues host memcpy for many small KV chunks, causing host-side serialization. Suggest change prefetch strategy: batch-aligned prefetch and skip prefetch when contiguous KV segments are likely. Also consider moving dequant to GPU (fp16 conversion) to avoid host roundtrip.

devin: +1. I'll add CUPTI async memcpy counters and run a 10k-sample NVPROF sweep with --print-gpu-trace to confirm launch serialization vs kernel stalls. Also test a variant that does in-GPU dequant (fp16 path).

maria: Nice. I'll push a runtime flag to disable prefetch per-request so we can A/B compare in canary. Running 10k sample e2e now, will drop CSV of p50/p95/p99 and nvprof summaries here when finished.

sam: Perfect — if ablation confirms, we can ship a small heuristic tweak and roll canary. @maria please tag the perf traces in the PR. :thumbsup:
